# `move` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "move" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/move/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique move id, e.g. "sword-light-1". Stable once shipped (saves). |
| `schemaVersion` | `1` | `1` | MoveDef schema version, for future migrations. |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, design intent), for owner review. |
| `verb` | `"attack"` \| `"dodge"` \| `"parry"` | required | Combat verb: the stamina action and cancel-into category. |
| `frames` | object | required | Frame data in sim ticks (60 Hz); the move lasts startup + active + recovery ticks. |
| `frames.startup` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Windup ticks before the hit can land. |
| `frames.active` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Ticks the hitbox (or the dodge’s motion) is live. |
| `frames.recovery` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Ticks after active before the move ends. |
| `staminaCost` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Stamina points spent on the first startup tick. |
| `cancelWindows` | list of object | `[]` | Tick ranges in which the move may be cancelled into another action. |
| `cancelWindows[].into` | `"attack"` \| `"dodge"` \| `"block"` | required | What the move may be cancelled into. |
| `cancelWindows[].from` | integer ≥ 0 | required | First tick (inclusive), counted from the move’s first startup tick. |
| `cancelWindows[].to` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Last tick (inclusive); at least from, and inside the move. |
| `damage` | object | — | Damage packet template: what each hit applies through the damage model. Required with a hitbox. |
| `damage.amounts` | map of `"slash"` \| `"pierce"` \| `"blunt"` \| `"fire"` \| `"frost"` \| `"shock"` \| `"arcane"` \| `"poison"` → number ≥ 0 | required | Damage points per damage type (before resistances); unlisted types deal 0. |
| `damage.poiseDamage` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Poise damage in points. |
| `damage.staminaDamage` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Stamina drained from a blocker, in points (before shield stability). |
| `damage.impulse` | object | `{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0}` | Knockback impulse, N·s, in the attacker’s frame (+z forward, +y up). |
| `damage.impulse.x` | number | required |  |
| `damage.impulse.y` | number | required |  |
| `damage.impulse.z` | number | required |  |
| `damage.impactForce` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Peak impact force, N (breakables, knockdown). |
| `damage.tags` | list of id | `[]` | Damage-packet tags every hit carries, e.g. "critical" (damage model tags). |
| `hitbox` | object | — | Hit volume of a move that can hit; absent = it never hits (dodges, parries). |
| `hitbox.track` | id | required | Socket track id (e04.2) that animates the volume across the active ticks, e.g. "knight-sword-arc-light-1". |
| `hitbox.shape` | object | required | Hit volume in the attacker’s frame at the track’s rest pose, metres, using the stimulus shape vocabulary: { kind: "sphere", center, radius }, { kind: "capsule", from, to, radius } or { kind: "box", center, halfExtents }. |
| `hitbox.shape.kind` | `"sphere"` | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.center` | object | required | Centre, metres, attacker frame. |
| `hitbox.shape.center.x` | number | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.center.y` | number | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.center.z` | number | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.radius` | number > 0 | required | Radius, metres. |
| `hitbox.shape.kind` | `"capsule"` | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.from` | object | required | One end of the axis (e.g. the hilt), metres, attacker frame. |
| `hitbox.shape.from.x` | number | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.from.y` | number | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.from.z` | number | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.to` | object | required | Other end of the axis (e.g. the tip), metres, attacker frame. |
| `hitbox.shape.to.x` | number | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.to.y` | number | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.to.z` | number | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.radius` | number > 0 | required | Radius around the axis, metres. |
| `hitbox.shape.kind` | `"box"` | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.halfExtents` | object | required | Half the size on each axis, metres. |
| `hitbox.shape.halfExtents.x` | number > 0 | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.halfExtents.y` | number > 0 | required |  |
| `hitbox.shape.halfExtents.z` | number > 0 | required |  |
| `hitbox.reach` | `"close"` \| `"short"` \| `"medium"` \| `"long"` | required | Reach class for AI spacing. |
| `hitbox.swing` | `"horizontal"` \| `"vertical"` \| `"thrust"` | required | Swing motion: horizontal, vertical or thrust. |
| `hitbox.friendlyFire` | boolean | — | The volume also strikes the attacker’s allies (e04.2), so creatures can be tricked into hitting each other; absent = false (allies are ignored). |
| `flags` | object | `{}` | Defence-related flags and tick windows. |
| `flags.parryable` | boolean | `true` | A parry in its window deflects it (e04.12). Only meaningful with a hitbox. |
| `flags.unblockable` | boolean | `false` | Passes through shields (grabs, some slams); otherwise a hitting move is blockable. |
| `flags.parryNote` | string | — | Why a move is both parryable and unblockable (silences that warning). |
| `flags.interruptible` | boolean | `false` | A shield bash (e04.14) can interrupt it, e.g. spell windups. |
| `flags.hyperarmor` | object | — | Ticks during which hits do not interrupt the move, up to poiseCap poise damage. |
| `flags.hyperarmor.from` | integer ≥ 0 | required | First tick (inclusive), counted from the move’s first startup tick. |
| `flags.hyperarmor.to` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Last tick (inclusive); at least from, and inside the move. |
| `flags.hyperarmor.poiseCap` | number > 0 | required | Poise damage it absorbs before it breaks, in points. |
| `flags.iframes` | object | — | Invulnerable ticks: hits apply no damage, poise or reaction (e04.8). |
| `flags.iframes.from` | integer ≥ 0 | required | First tick (inclusive), counted from the move’s first startup tick. |
| `flags.iframes.to` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Last tick (inclusive); at least from, and inside the move. |
| `telegraphTick` | integer ≥ 0 | `0` | Tick the telegraph (TelegraphStarted, e04.20) fires; before the first active tick. |
| `chainNext` | ref → move | — | Move the next attack press chains into (e.g. light 1 → light 2); absent = none. |
| `charge` | object | — | A charged move: its damage and stamina cost are the full-charge values, lerped from `from` by hold time (e04.13). |
| `charge.from` | ref → move | required | The uncharged move this is the full charge of (e.g. the heavy). |
| `charge.minHoldTicks` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Hold ticks below which the uncharged move is used instead. |
| `charge.fullHoldTicks` | integer > 0 | required | Hold ticks at which the charge is full; values lerp from the uncharged move. |
| `charge.autoReleaseTicks` | integer > 0 | required | Hold ticks at which it releases on its own. |
| `presentation` | object | required | Presentation ids: unknown ids warn (assets may lag) but never fail validation. |
| `presentation.anim` | string | required | Animation clip id (style bible §15.1), e.g. "anim-knight-sword-light-1". |
| `presentation.audioCue` | string | — | Audio cue id (audio bible §6) of the move’s sound, e.g. "sfx-knight-swing-light". |
| `presentation.vfxCue` | string | — | VFX cue id (style bible §15.1), e.g. "vfx-sword-trail-light". |
